content.text:
**Context:** Finishing Codex review 3 (benchmarks script, defense tempo parse, review 2 round 5 fixes) on the `pl_bands` GPS analysis in DataBase_GPS_Reporting, then handing results to the user.

**Key Exchanges:**
- Defense tempo labels: the face parser now reads DEF tabs as well as OFF tabs, so each athlete gets his own side's tempo label. DEF and OFF scripted minutes match on all 38 practice days, and 197 of 198 practice periods matched a face period on each side.
- Main finding: defensive teach periods run hot (0.83 High-Load s/min), while offensive teach periods are light (0.17–0.47). The same UNIT TEACH period is a teaching period for the offense but near team-period effort for the defense.
- Limit: 87% of defense face periods have no tempo label, so defense numbers can't be split by tempo in more detail.
- Codex review 3 ran 5 rounds and found 11 findings, all fixed and pushed (final commit `ef84448`). Commits along the way: `b397084`, `65b2c90`, `f8fd519`, `6706f60`, `e067293`.
- The user ran `period_view.py` and got "no such file or directory". Cause: the command only works from the project folder, and the earlier message omitted the `cd`. The fix given:
  - `cd ~/DEV/DataBase_GPS_Reporting`
  - `gps_report/.venv/bin/python analysis/pl_bands/period_view.py`
  - The tempo table is section D.

**Decisions Made:**
- 2025 position medians now use the same 3-week rule as 2026 (DL 25.5, was 22.5; LB 48, was 44.5), for consistency across seasons.
- The camp table now has a separate game-week-1 block and a practice count per block, so short blocks are visible. Camp wk 4 is only 1 practice in 2025 and 3 in 2026.
- The mock game is no longer counted in camp.
- The user asked to be texted when the whole Codex loop finished (not per round), and this was done.

**Lessons Learned:**
- An earlier claim was wrong: "every game ran 2.8–3.3 High-Load s per snap." The real range is 2.35–3.30, and 15 of 19 games fall in 2.8–3.3. The README was corrected.
- Camp/game block comparisons (camp weeks 1–3 vs game week 1):

  | Season | Camp weeks 1–3 | Game week 1 |
  |---|---|---|
  | 2026 | 45–49 | 43.6 |
  | 2025 | 31–35 | 30.1 |

- Positions come from each athlete's current Catapult roster entry because the database keeps no position history. A player who changed position counts in the new group for all of his weeks.
- Instructions given to the user should include the `cd` into the project directory, since commands use relative paths.

**Action Items:**
- The round 5 fixes came after the round limit, so Codex never reviewed them. Consider a further review if wanted.
- Awaiting the user's confirmation that the `cd` fix resolved the error. If not, the user will paste the full error.
